title: Schema Lab: an example publishing package for single-author microjournals
description: Schema Lab is a minimal, working example of a publishing package for a single-author microjournal. Articles are Markdown files checked against a versioned schema; one set of templates produces each article's web page, a matching PDF and its entry in an issue's table of contents. Issues collect published articles automatically, schemas are locked once used by a published article, and a manual workflow gives each published article its own Zenodo DOI, with a sandbox mode for testing. Built with Jekyll, Python (ReportLab) and GitHub Actions; published on GitHub Pages.
